items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: But my father is definitely a Beethoven/Mozart/Mahler/Bruckner kind of guy.

ctx.x: How about your father, your parents?

My father is still alive. He’s actually turning 86 tomorrow and he’s still going strong. We actually still go hiking together a lot. My mother, unfortunately she passed away in 2016 but she really has been my musical guide early in my life. She was a music teacher and she was the one who got me started on the recorder and piano lessons and her love for music and for the arts really lives very strongly in me and I’m very thankful for that. And even though both my parents don’t understand anything about jazz really…
I loved the anecdote that you wrote about your father conducting the Vienna Philharmonic with headphones on.
